name: DHAA photo-oxidation in crude A. annua extract, flow (Triemer 2018, ESI Table S4)
source: S. Triemer et al., Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 2018, 57, 5525; ESI Table S4 (undiluted extract, 0.5 M DHAA, 7 bar, 660 nm, 25 C, 5 mL photoreactor, liquid:O2 = 1:4 v/v). Template at 0.2 mL/min; other flow rates in scripts/triemer_sweep.py.

materials.name: O2 (4 x liquid flow at 7 bar, 25 C)
materials.note: 7 atm x 4 V_liq / RT; 2.29 equiv. at every flow rate

materials.name: dried A. annua leaves (extracted)

notes: Photo-oxidation step only; cooling and gas delivery not inventoried.
